requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can add a new hire

criteria.must: An HR Coordinator can submit a new hire's name, role, and start date
The new hire appears in the list of new hires after being added

requirements.statement: Adding a new hire automatically generates their onboarding checklist from the standard template

criteria.must: Every task defined in the standard template appears on the new hire's checklist immediately after they are added
The HR Coordinator does not need to add any task manually for a newly created new hire

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can view every task for a given new hire across HR, IT, and Facilities in one place

criteria.must: The new hire detail view lists tasks owned by HR, IT, and Facilities together
Each listed task shows its owning team

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can manage the standard onboarding task template

criteria.must: An HR Coordinator can add a new task to the template with a title, owning team, and due offset
An HR Coordinator can edit an existing template task's title, owning team, or due offset
An HR Coordinator can remove a task from the template

requirements.statement: An IT Staff member sees a queue of only the IT tasks across all new hires

criteria.must: The IT task queue lists IT-owned tasks from every new hire
The IT task queue does not include HR- or Facilities-owned tasks

requirements.statement: A Facilities Staff member sees a queue of only the Facilities tasks across all new hires

criteria.must: The Facilities task queue lists Facilities-owned tasks from every new hire
The Facilities task queue does not include HR- or IT-owned tasks

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can complete their own HR tasks for a new hire

criteria.must: An HR Coordinator can mark an HR-owned task complete
A completed HR task is reflected as complete in the new hire's cross-team view

requirements.statement: An IT Staff member can mark an IT task complete

criteria.must: An IT Staff member can mark an IT-owned task complete from the IT queue
A completed IT task is visible as complete to an HR Coordinator viewing that new hire

requirements.statement: A Facilities Staff member can mark a Facilities task complete

criteria.must: A Facilities Staff member can mark a Facilities-owned task complete from the Facilities queue
A completed Facilities task is visible as complete to an HR Coordinator viewing that new hire

requirements.statement: Each team is alerted when one of its tasks for a new hire becomes overdue

criteria.must: A pending task whose due date has passed is flagged as overdue in its owning team's queue
A pending task whose due date has not yet passed is not flagged as overdue
A completed task is never flagged as overdue even if its due date has passed
